skill.name: Commit/Position
skill.strategic_description: Commits the current falling jewel column into the left well, fixing its top/mid/bot pieces into stack positions and updating the active match-clear alignment goal.

steps: Observe current item position and intended placement region
Select the target placement that satisfies current alignment goal
Irreversibly place the item into the chosen target region
Confirm placement is fixed and goal state updated
abort_criteria: No progress toward skill objective after several moves

contract.name: Drop Into Position
contract.description: Use this when the falling 3-jewel column is already aligned with the target lane and rotation is set: commit to that column and let it drop straight down. It secures exact placement for making or setting up vertical, horizontal, or diagonal matches.

Confirm the column is fully aligned with the left well
Commit the column into the left well by pressing the commit button

The top, mid, and bottom pieces are fixed into the stack positions

abort_criteria: The column is no longer falling

skill.name: Inspect/Setup
skill.strategic_description: Re-identifies the current board/UI into a fresh falling three-jewel column (red-purple-blue) with score/level/jewels counters visible, effectively setting up the next move rather than changing the left-well region.

Choose the reset or setup transition for next cycle
Trigger the selected reinitialization or preparation action
Confirm fresh controllable state appears and stabilizes
abort_criteria: No progress toward skill objective after several moves

contract.name: Rotate Opening Column
contract.description: Rotate the falling three-jewel column as soon as it appears so the top, middle, and bottom gems are reordered before placement. Use this during setup to put the needed color on the bottom or align future vertical, horizontal, or diagonal matches.
